summary: Copies status field values from the global vehicle block array (base 0x005ECDC8, 18624-byte stride indexed by a2) into three target field arrays carried on this (this+0x4C, this+0x58, this+0x64), each value stored through ShortComputation_e710. The a3 flag selects the source: non-zero reads the vehicle block, zero writes a 0 (reset). Copies 4 fields from block+324 (74-dword stride), 2 fields from block dword indices 377/394, and 8 fields from block+1644 (17-dword stride).

local_names.this: target object carrying the three destination field arrays
local_names.a2: vehicle index into the 18624-byte-stride global block array
local_names.a3: copy mode: non-zero copies source values, zero resets targets to 0
local_names.v3: base of the selected vehicle status block (unk_5ECDC8 + 18624*a2)
local_names.v5: group-1 source pointer starting at block+324, stepping 74 dwords
local_names.v11: group-3 source pointer starting at block+1644, stepping 17 dwords

operations.description: v3 = &unk_5ECDC8 + 18624*a2: base of the selected vehicle status block, striding the global array at 0x005ECDC8 by 18624 bytes per vehicle index
Group 1: do-while of 4 iterations; source pointer starts at block+324 and steps 74 dwords per iteration; target pointer starts at this+0x4C + 144*a2 and steps 36 bytes per iteration
Per-copy guard on a3 within group 1: non-zero reads the source field value, zero forces the copied value to 0 (reset)
ShortComputation_e710((this[19] + running offset), value) stores each group-1 status value into the target field array at this+0x4C
Group 2: for-loop of 2 iterations over the target array at this+0x58; target index is (i + 2*a2) * 36 bytes; source is block dword 377 for i==0 and block dword 394 for i==1
Per-copy guard on a3 within group 2: non-zero reads the block field (dword 377/394), zero forces the copied value to 0
ShortComputation_e710((this[22] + 36*(i + 2*a2)), value) stores each group-2 status value into the target field array at this+0x58
Group 3: do-while of 8 iterations; source pointer starts at block+1644 and steps 17 dwords per iteration; target pointer starts at this+0x64 + 288*a2 and steps 36 bytes per iteration
Per-copy guard on a3 within group 3: non-zero reads the source field value, zero forces the copied value to 0
ShortComputation_e710((this[25] + running offset), value) stores each group-3 status value into the target field array at this+0x64; the last call's result becomes the function return value
Returns the final ShortComputation_e710 result; the function is invoked by VehicleGraphicsSceneLoader (0x004DFCE0) and VehicleResetClear (0x004E09E0)

unresolved: The three groups use different source strides (74 dwords, fixed dword indices 377/394, 17 dwords) and target arrays (this+0x4C, this+0x58, this+0x64); the identity of each individual status field within the vehicle block is not documented
Group-2 source dword indices 377 and 394 do not fall on the same layout grid as groups 1 and 3, so the block element semantics remain unknown
